facts.fact: UNICEF Zimbabwe states that more than 20 Civil Registry Department registry offices and sub-offices have been computerised, with no total of offices given, and names digital registration as operational at Mpilo Hospital in Bulawayo, Kariangwe in Binga, Bubi, Manama Mission Hospital in Gwanda, Mahusekwa, Murambinda and Epworth; no date is given for the count, so the publication date is used.
facts.system: computerised civil registration offices and sub-offices

facts.fact: UNICEF Zimbabwe states that at the fully computerised civil registration sub-office at Mpilo Hospital, 200 metres from the maternity ward, mothers register newborns and obtain a birth certificate before discharge, and that a client at the Bubi office received a computerised birth certificate the same day; it does not say deaths are entered digitally (publication date used).
facts.system: computerised civil registration offices and sub-offices

facts.fact: UNICEF Zimbabwe states that the computerised registry offices and sub-offices allow real-time data entry and faster document processing at the office; it does not say where the record is held or whether the offices are online to a national register (publication date used).
facts.system: computerised civil registration offices and sub-offices

facts.fact: UNICEF Zimbabwe states that the Civil Registry Department is itself digitalising its registration systems, and quotes the Secretary for Home Affairs and Cultural Heritage on the digitalisation (publication date used).
facts.system: computerised civil registration offices and sub-offices

facts.fact: UNICEF Zimbabwe states that the computerisation of the Civil Registry sub-office at Mpilo Hospital had UNICEF's support; it names no domestic budget line and no amount for the computerisation (publication date used).
facts.system: computerised civil registration offices and sub-offices

facts.fact: UNICEF Zimbabwe reports in July 2025 that digital registration is now also operational in rural and peri-urban offices including Kariangwe in Binga, Bubi, Manama Mission Hospital, Mahusekwa, Murambinda and Epworth, describing it as an expansion; no start dates are given, so the publication date is used.
facts.system: computerised civil registration offices and sub-offices
